 News › News News › RRB JE CBT 1 admit card 2026 out: Download hall ticket link for 4,029 vacancies RRB JE CBT 1 admit card 2026 out: Download hall ticket link for 4,029 vacancies
 Sajid Raza Published: Oct 23, 2026, 17:08 IST Updated: Oct 23, 2026, 17:08 IST RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026 Out RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026 is released on 23rd October 2026 for those candidates who appeared for the first stage Computer Based Test (CBT 1) on 27th October 2026. The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has issued hall tickets for Junior Engineer Post and candidates can download their hall tickets online by filling their Registration No and Date of Birth.
 RRB JE recruitment examination is conducted as a part of Centralised Employment Notice (CEN) No. 04/2026 for the posts of Junior Engineer (JE), Depot Material Superintendent (DMS) and Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA). It has a total of 4,029 vacancies.
 The candidate is advised to download RRB JE CBT 1 Admit card from its official website, and verify Exam Date, Reporting Time, Shift & Centre Address. The Admit Card is an important document for the entry into the examination hall.
 RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026: Highlights 
 Particulars Details 
 Examination RRB JE CBT 1 2026 
 Conducting Authority Railway Recruitment Boards 
 Recruitment Notification CEN 04/2026 
 Posts Junior Engineer, DMS and CMA 
 Total Vacancies 4,029 
 Admit Card Status Released 
 Admit Card Release Date October 23, 2026 
 CBT 1 Exam Dates October 27 and 28, 2026 
 Examination Mode Computer-Based Test 
 Login Details Registration Number and Date of Birth 
 Official Website rrb.indianrailways.gov.in 
 How to Download RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026? 
 Candidates can follow these simple steps to download the RRB JE Hall Ticket 2026.
 Visit the official Railway Recruitment Board website at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in .
 Open the website of the regional RRB through which you applied.
 Find the link for RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026 under CEN 04/2026.
 Click on the admit card or e-call letter download link.
 Enter your registration number and date of birth as required.
 Complete the captcha verification, if applicable.
 Submit the details to view your admit card.
 Download the hall ticket and take a clear printout.
 Candidates should verify all the details printed on the admit card before the examination day. If there is any error, they should contact the concerned regional RRB through its official helpdesk.
 RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026 Release Date 
 The Railway Recruitment Boards release admit cards a few days before the examination. The city intimation slip is issued earlier to help candidates plan their travel to the examination city.
 The important dates are given below.
 Event Date 
 RRB JE City Intimation Slip October 17 and 18, 2026 
 Admit Card for October 27 Exam October 23, 2026 
 Admit Card for October 28 Exam October 24, 2026 
 RRB JE CBT 1 Examination October 27 and 28, 2026 
 Candidates should check the official portal for the latest updates and download their hall ticket as soon as it becomes available.
 RRB JE CBT 1 Exam Pattern 2026 
 The first-stage RRB JE Computer-Based Test assesses candidates in mathematics, general intelligence and reasoning, general awareness, and general science.
 The examination pattern is given below.
 Subject Number of Questions Marks 
 Mathematics 30 30 
 General Intelligence and Reasoning 25 25 
 General Awareness 15 15 
 General Science 30 30 
 Total 100 100 
 The examination duration is 90 minutes under the standard arrangement. 
 There is a negative marking of one-third of a mark for each incorrect answer. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the complete examination scheme and applicable rules.
 Details Mentioned on RRB JE Hall Ticket 2026 
 The RRB JE CBT 1 admit card contains important information about the candidate and the examination. Candidates should check the following details after downloading it:
 Candidate's name
 Roll number and registration number
 Photograph and signature
 Examination date
 Examination shift and timing
 Reporting time and gate-closing time
 Examination centre name and address
 Important instructions for the examination
 If any information is incorrect or unclear, candidates should contact the regional RRB as soon as possible.
 Documents Required for RRB JE CBT 1 Exam 2026 
 Candidates should prepare all the required documents before leaving for the examination centre.
 The documents generally include:
 A printed copy of the RRB JE CBT 1 admit card.
 An original, valid photo identity document accepted under the examination instructions.
 Recent passport-size photographs, if required by the official instructions.
 Any additional document specifically mentioned on the admit card.
 Candidates should carefully read the examination-day guidelines printed on their hall ticket. They should avoid carrying mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators or other prohibited electronic devices into the examination hall.
